name: Rosemary Shipwreck Casserole
description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, and a tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine beef, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place potatoes in the bottom of a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Cover onion layer with the beef mixture.
Spoon pork and beans over the beef layer.
Pour tomato soup over the pork and beans.
Cover the casserole and bake for 1 hour or until done.

keywords: shipwreck casserole, ground beef, potato casserole
